verdict.rationale: Exa's Contents API explicitly returns 'clean page content from URLs, handling JavaScript-rendered pages, PDFs, and complex layouts automatically,' and this full-content extraction is also bundled into Search results (up to 10 per search) rather than being limited to snippets, with a token-efficient full-text mode described as '10x token efficient extracts.' Missing for 10: explicit documentation of markdown as an output format option, and independent/hands-on developer confirmation of full-text/markdown extraction quality.
